card.name: Edition numbers in book citations
card.fires_on: The ordinal or qualifier just before 'ed.' or 'edition' in a reference list entry, such as 6th, 2nd, fourth or revised. It appears in citations of books and encyclopedias.

modes.label: Ordinal before ed.
modes.description: A number ending such as th, nd, rd or d that follows a book title and precedes 'ed.' or 'edition'.

modes.label: Revised or spelled-out edition
modes.description: The word 'revised' or a spelled-out ordinal placed right before 'edition' in a citation.
modes.example: The signet Mosby medical encyclopedia (re<<vised>> edition)

card.writes: It promotes edition and version words, so the model predicts 'edition' or 'ed.' next.
card.plain: It spots the spot in a book citation where the edition number is given, just before the word edition.
